summary: Iteration 100 - Verified email inline logo (cid attachment), 'başvuru nolu' subject prefix, homepage bundle-adds-visa flow, /sepet visa line + visa-checkout panel, apply-form preselection & extras import, and visa comparison child row. 15/15 emailer pytest cases PASS + 1 real end-to-end application through POST /api/applications with Resend accepting the send (status='sent') and outbox HTML containing the public logo URL (no cid:). All frontend flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: emailer.py: _resend_params uses list(logo) to pass raw bytes as int list to Resend SDK; SDK now accepts base64 string too - list is fine but heavier over the wire. Consider base64.b64encode(logo).decode() for smaller payload.
/app/frontend/src/pages/Cart.jsx is ~820 lines; still under 700-line guideline but growing - extraction of CheckoutForm + VisaCheckoutPanel would help.
Apply.jsx is 3660 lines - well past 700 - split into step components strongly recommended.

In HomeBundleStrip.jsx the CTA link 'Bu paketle başvur' does not pass ?sepet=1 and does not import cart extras; only the bottom 'Paketi sepete ekle' button seeds cart. That is intentional but the two flows can confuse users; consider unifying.
test_credentials: Admin: python /app/backend/admin_test_token.py (JWT). Emails routed only to delivered@resend.dev.
seed_data_creation: One test application (contact.email=delivered@resend.dev) created and DELETED. Related email_outbox rows also purged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Emailer inline-logo: _logo_payload() reads /app/backend/assets/email-logo.png (verified PNG magic). _resend_params includes attachments only when html contains 'cid:dvh-logo'. _record_attempt rewrites html cid->public URL before storing in email_outbox so admin preview /admin/e-postalar shows the logo. subject_with_ref(ref, tail) returns '{ref} başvuru nolu Dubai vize başvurunuz {tail}' (or just 'Dubai vize başvurunuz {tail}' if ref empty). Real E2E via POST /api/applications produced email_notification='sent' — Resend accepted the send with the attachment. Frontend: home bundle 'Paketi sepete ekle' adds visa+insurance+eSIM (badge 3). /sepet shows cart-visa-line, stepper works, cart-total=1.170₺, cart-grand-total=6.360₺. cart-visa-apply-button navigates to /basvuru?vize=visa_30_single&paket=pack_standard&sepet=1 and primary-visa-select is preselected. Removing visa restores cart-checkout-button. Visa comparison child row shows 2.470₺ (30 single) 5.190₺ (60 single) and 'Çocuk vizesi tek girişlidir' for multi columns. Family note visible.
rca of the issue: N/A — all fixes from this session validated end-to-end. No regressions found.
